registryEntry.label: Turn On Microsoft Defender Network Protection in Block Mode (Intune Settings Catalog, all devices)
registryEntry.get_command: $p = @((Invoke-MgGraphRequest -Uri 'https://graph.microsoft.us/beta/deviceManagement/configurationPolicies?$expand=settings,assignments').value | Where-Object { $_.name -eq 'CMMC-NetworkProtection' }) | Select-Object -First 1; if ($p) { [pscustomobject]@{ name = $p.name; networkProtection = (@($p.settings | ForEach-Object { $_.settingInstance } | Where-Object { $_.settingDefinitionId -eq 'device_vendor_msft_policy_config_defender_enablenetworkprotection' }) | Select-Object -First 1).choiceSettingValue.value; assignments = @($p.assignments) } | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 10 }
registryEntry.set_command: $existing = @((Invoke-MgGraphRequest -Uri 'https://graph.microsoft.us/beta/deviceManagement/configurationPolicies').value | Where-Object { $_.name -eq 'CMMC-NetworkProtection' }); if ($existing.Count -gt 0) { Write-Output 'CMMC-NetworkProtection already exists' } else { $created = Invoke-MgGraphRequest -Method POST -Uri 'https://graph.microsoft.us/beta/deviceManagement/configurationPolicies' -Body (@{name='CMMC-NetworkProtection';description='CMMC SC.L1-3.13.1 boundary protection - Defender network protection in block mode';platforms='windows10';technologies='mdm';settings=@(@{'@odata.type'='#microsoft.graph.deviceManagementConfigurationSetting';settingInstance=@{'@odata.type'='#microsoft.graph.deviceManagementConfigurationChoiceSettingInstance';settingDefinitionId='device_vendor_msft_policy_config_defender_enablenetworkprotection';choiceSettingValue=@{'@odata.type'='#microsoft.graph.deviceManagementConfigurationChoiceSettingValue';value='device_vendor_msft_policy_config_defender_enablenetworkprotection_1'}}})} | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 20) -ContentType 'application/json'; Invoke-MgGraphRequest -Method POST -Uri "https://graph.microsoft.us/beta/deviceManagement/configurationPolicies/$($created.id)/assign" -Body (@{assignments=@(@{target=@{'@odata.type'='#microsoft.graph.allDevicesAssignmentTarget'}})} | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 10) -ContentType 'application/json' | Out-Null; $created | Select-Object id,name | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 5 }
